_comment: Hand-written timeline events and test runs that are not in the game repo (they come from the build session and the agents' reports). update.py merges these with git log and PROGRESS.md. Times are the Mac's local time (+10:00). An event with a `progress` key is matched to that PROGRESS.md section, so update.py doesn't add a duplicate for it.

events.title: Planning docs written
events.text: Eleven commits in eight minutes (16:22-16:30): README, agent rules, PLAN, GDD, ECONOMY, DELIVERY_VAN, ARCHITECTURE, REUSE, ASSETS, VISUALS and MILESTONES (M0-M9 with acceptance checks). No game code yet.

events.title: "Build my full game... grill me first"
events.text: Before any code, the user was grilled with 7 questions. Answers: run M0-M9 straight through; a scripted bot plus a playtest checklist instead of manual play; tune to the ECONOMY.md pacing table; a Sandbox picker for start level and money; Kevin MacLeod CC-BY music; clean the disk as you go; then a critique-and-fix review loop. Recorded in PLAN.md (497870a, 16:51).

events.title: M0: Fork and world shell
events.text: One agent (BuildM0), about 57 minutes. Mimic Mart's assets copied without the horror content; all 48 products, 9 licences and 18 fixtures in data/*.json; the shop shell generated from unlocked cells; car park, road and neighbours; daylight HDRI lighting; the player controller; the test harness. 71 tests passing, 60 fps on the Medium preset. Finished 17:47 (7b31b72).

events.title: First user bug reports
events.text: "You can't move the camera with the mouse and the cash register screen is glitchy at angles." Fixed within 13 minutes: the crosshair control was swallowing mouse look (c75517e, 18:18) and the POS screen was z-fighting with its glass (640a314, 18:21).

events.title: Testing on hold
events.text: The user asked to hold off testing. M1 (the stock loop and the van, 28b6b41) and M2 (customers and checkout) were written blind: no Godot run, nothing parsed or executed.

events.title: The user's `gt` lifts the hold
events.text: The user's new `gt` tool runs headless Godot tests through one shared queue and lock, caches results and keeps everything off the screen and inside the 8 GB of RAM. The first run on the blind M1 code: 136 passed, 2 failed, plus ~300 stock-box errors. VerifyM1 started fixing it.

events.title: Up to 6 agents in parallel
events.text: AssetsBatch and BuildM3 (18:50), BuildM5 (19:10), BuildM4 and BuildM6 (19:27), BuildM8 (19:35), alongside VerifyM1 and BuildM2. Each worked in its own git worktree and branch, rebased onto main to land, and queued for the one Godot lock through `gt`.

events.title: M2: Customers and checkout
events.text: 14 shoppers with shopping lists, a baked navmesh, baskets and trolleys, speech bubbles, queues, click-to-scan, a typed card keypad and hand-counted AUD cash change with 5c rounding (d96b0d3).

events.title: Main broke, and was fixed within minutes
events.text: An agent committed a one-file PROGRESS.md change with `git commit -a`, which swept another agent's half-done edits from the shared working tree into main (f6b2668). It was caught and fixed within minutes; the lesson: stage only your own files.

events.title: M3: Days, bills, loans, saves
events.text: Day phases from PREP to the receipt, rent, electricity, wages, loans, late fees and repossession, the Bank app, 3 save slots with autosave, the HUD and the Tab clipboard. A bot played 3 full days headless. Full suite: 599 passed, 3 failed (the M1 delivery tests still being fixed).

events.title: Assets batch for M4-M7
events.text: AssetsBatch: 30 new product models with packaging art and box prints, the M4-M7 fixtures, two uniformed staff humans, the remaining sounds (rendered offline with numpy) and six Kevin MacLeod music tracks. `Catalog.missing_models()` returned [].

events.title: M1: Stock loop and the van verified
events.progress: M1: Stock loop and the van (verified 2026-11-05)
events.text: VerifyM1 made the blind M1 code pass: stock-box parts found under the GLB root, boxes kept in the bay with probed spots and softened landings, and the van tuned to stop at about 4.5 s and leave at 14.05 s. 20/20 six-box and 44/44 forty-box runs landed every box. Full suite: 871 passed, 0 failed.

events.title: M5: Build mode, furniture, expansions, stockroom
events.progress: M5: Build mode, furniture, expansions, stockroom (2026-11-05)
events.text: Flat-pack furniture fired from the van, build mode with placement rules, expansions E1-E8 knocking walls down with dust and camera shake, and the stockroom shed S1-S3 with storage racks. Landed at 710 passed, 4 failed (one flaky rack step in the acceptance bot).

events.title: M8: Menus, tutorial, polish
events.text: Main menu over a dolly shot of a stocked store, Sandbox picker, options with mixer buses, the day-1 tutorial, Dale handing over the keys, the music player and the F3 overlay. menu_test 75 passed, tutorial_test 15 passed.

events.title: M4: Progression and reputation
events.text: Level-up banner and confetti, licences, daily market drift, the Pricing and Stats apps, cleanliness with spills, litter and the mop, and promo stands. The progression bot reached level 3 on day 5.

events.title: M6: Staff
events.text: Cashiers, restockers and cleaners with three tiers and wages, plus the Staff app. In the acceptance day, two cashiers served 79 customers ($653.60) with no change mistakes. Full suite: 928 passed, 0 failed.

events.title: M7: Content complete
events.text: All 48 products ordered, stocked, bought and sold end to end; the deli corner, the cigarette wall and Smokes at the till; aisle signs; verge trees; parked cars that follow trade. The level-16 test store held 11,164 units on 564 slots. Full suite: 999 passed, 0 failed.

events.title: Leftovers fixed: 1041 green
events.text: FixLeftovers: the ShopOS dock was covering the bottom of every app window, the rack box couldn't be targeted, and the progression tour bot was stuck. The progression tour passes. Full suite: 1041 passed, 0 failed.

events.title: M9 started: balance, perf, soak
events.text: BuildM9 built a soak bot that plays N days of a new game through the real van, till and build mode, and cut mesh surfaces from 5,749 to 3,893 in the headless perf pass. Its last 30-day run had 0 errors and no stuck NPCs. Tuning met 3 of the 5 pacing rows before the agent's budget ran out; the work is on the m9-build branch.

events.title: Review round 1
events.text: An independent reviewer (Review1) critiqued the build: 20 issues (1 blocker crash from selling a till with a queue, 6 major, 13 minor) and 8 suggested additions. Its own full-suite run was 1041 passed, 0 failed.

events.title: Review additions, batch A
events.text: Catch boxes out of the air, van misfires that set off a car alarm, the store phone, the My Store look app, Sunday's Corner Courier review quoting real customers, and MegaMart's rival sale week. Full suite: 1162 passed, 0 failed.

events.title: Round-1 fixes land
events.text: FixRound1 fixed 15 of the review's 16 bug and UX items, writing a regression test for each (1205 passed, 0 failed). The crash fix refuses to sell a till that has a queue.

events.title: FinishM9 picks up M9
events.text: A new agent continues from the m9-build branch: more pacing tuning, ECONOMY.md updates and soaks. In progress.

events.title: NPC re-pathing fixed: 1225 green
events.progress: Round-1 review fixes (2026-11-06, FixRound1 and FixNPCRepath)
events.text: FixNPCRepath: walkers re-route when a fixture moves or the navmesh is rebaked, and stand and wait instead of walking through walls when there is no route. The new tests failed on the old code (13/20) and pass now. Full suite: 1225 passed, 0 failed.

events.title: Review additions, batch B started
events.text: Customer types, a requests board with daily goals, supplier deals and shoplifters. In progress.
